# Patch File Formatsvg image

## Purpose and Scopesvg image

This document specifies the structure and syntax of patch files used by Contexter's update system. Patch files encode incremental changes between two versions of context files (either Markdown or HTML), enabling efficient version control and update distribution.

For information about the commands that generate patches, see [Update Commands](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3-update-commands). For information about the source and target context file formats, see [Markdown Context Format](/ray0404/Contexter/7.1-markdown-context-format) and [HTML Context Format](/ray0404/Contexter/7.2-html-context-format).

## Overviewsvg image

Contexter supports two patch file formats that mirror its dual context file formats:

| Format | File Extension | Generator Commands | Applicator Commands | Cross-Format Support |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Markdown Patch** | `.md` | `updatecontext`, `smartupdate`, `updatecontexthtml` | `updater`, `updaterhtml` | Yes - can apply to HTML contexts |
| **HTML Patch** | `.html` | `updatecontexthtml` | `updaterhtml` | Yes - can apply to Markdown contexts |

Both formats internally use **unified diff format** (as defined by the GNU `diff` utility and the Python `patch` library) to represent file-level changes. The Markdown and HTML variants differ only in their container structure, not in the diff encoding itself.

**Key Design Characteristics:**

- **Per-file granularity**: Each modified file gets its own diff section
- **Self-describing**: File paths are embedded in the patch structure
- **Format-agnostic diffs**: The same unified diff content works for both MD and HTML patches
- **Library-based parsing**: Uses the `patch` Python library for diff interpretation

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md28-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L28-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L176)

## Markdown Patch Format Specificationsvg image

### Structuresvg image

A Markdown patch file consists of one or more **diff sections**, each representing changes to a single file. Each section follows this structure:

```px-2
--- DIFF FOR: {file_path} ---
```

{unified\_diff\_content}

```px-2
--- DIFF FOR: {next_file_path} ---
...
```

### Syntax Rulessvg image

1. **Section Header**: Each diff section begins with a line matching the pattern:

   ```px-2
   ^--- DIFF FOR: (.*) ---$
   ```

   Where the capture group contains the file path relative to the project root.
2. **Code Fence**: Immediately after the header line, a blank line is typically present, followed by opening code fence (```` ``` ````) without language specifier.
3. **Diff Content**: Contains standard unified diff format output with:

   - Hunk headers (`@@` lines)
   - Context lines (no prefix)
   - Deletion lines (`-` prefix)
   - Addition lines (`+` prefix)
4. **Closing Fence**: The diff section ends with a closing code fence (```` ``` ````).
5. **Repetition**: Additional files follow the same pattern.

### Examplesvg image

@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
def main():

- print("Hello")

- print("Hello, World!")
- return 0

```px-2
--- DIFF FOR: README.md ---
```

@@ -10,3 +10,4 @@

## Featuressvg image

- Feature A
- Feature B
  +- Feature C

### Parsing Implementationsvg image

The Markdown patch parser is implemented in `_parse_md_patch()`:

- **Pattern matching**: Uses regex `^--- DIFF FOR: (.*) ---$` to identify section headers [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py144](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L144-L144)
- **Line-by-line processing**: Iterates through file lines, accumulating diff content between fences [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py146-159](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L146-L159)
- **Patch object creation**: Converts accumulated diff lines to `patch.PatchSet` objects via `patch.fromstring()` [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py150-159](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L150-L159)
- **Dictionary output**: Returns `{file_path: PatchSet}` mapping [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py141](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L141-L141)

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py139-161](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L139-L161)

## HTML Patch Format Specificationsvg image

### Structuresvg image

An HTML patch file is a complete HTML document containing **diff containers**, each representing changes to a single file. The overall structure:

### Syntax Rulessvg image

1. **Container Element**: Each diff is wrapped in a `<div>` with:

   - Class: `diff-container`
   - Attribute: `data-path="{file_path}"` - the relative file path
2. **Content Element**: Diff content is placed in a `<pre>` tag to preserve formatting (whitespace, line breaks)
3. **HTML Entity Encoding**: Special characters in diff content may be HTML-encoded (`&lt;`, `&gt;`, `&amp;`)
4. **Document Structure**: Full HTML document structure with proper DOCTYPE and encoding declaration

### Examplesvg image

### Parsing Implementationsvg image

The HTML patch parser is implemented in `_parse_html_patch()`:

- **BeautifulSoup parsing**: Loads HTML document into DOM tree [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py167-168](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L167-L168)
- **Container selection**: Finds all `<div class="diff-container">` elements [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py171](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L171-L171)
- **Path extraction**: Reads `data-path` attribute from each container [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py172](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L172-L172)
- **Content extraction**: Retrieves text from nested `<pre>` element [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py173](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L173-L173)
- **Patch object creation**: Converts text to `patch.PatchSet` via `patch.fromstring()` [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py175](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L175-L175)

## Unified Diff Content Formatsvg image

Both Markdown and HTML patch formats contain the same unified diff content, which follows the standard GNU diff format.

### Unified Diff Componentssvg image

| Component | Syntax | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Hunk Header** | `@@ -l,s +l,s @@` | Specifies line ranges: `-` for original file, `+` for modified file |
| **Context Line** | `{line}` | Unchanged line (space prefix) providing context |
| **Deletion Line** | `-{line}` | Line removed from original file |
| **Addition Line** | `+{line}` | Line added to modified file |

### Hunk Header Syntaxsvg image

```px-2
@@ -{start_line},{line_count} +{start_line},{line_count} @@
```

- **`-{start},{count}`**: In the original file, starting at line `start`, spanning `count` lines
- **`+{start},{count}`**: In the modified file, starting at line `start`, spanning `count` lines

### Example with Annotationssvg image

### Python Patch Library Integrationsvg image

Contexter uses the `patch` Python library to parse and apply unified diffs:

1. **String to PatchSet**: `patch.fromstring(diff_bytes)` converts raw diff text to structured object [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py150-175](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L150-L175)
2. **PatchSet Structure**: Contains list of patches, each with hunks representing file changes
3. **Application**: The library handles line-level merging, conflict detection, and offset adjustment

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py11](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L11-L11) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py150-175](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L150-L175) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml28](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L28-L28)

## Parsing and Application Flowsvg image

**Diagram: Patch Processing Pipeline**

### Auto-Detection Logicsvg image

The `parse_patch_file()` function automatically determines patch format based on file extension:

This enables cross-format patching: an HTML patch can be applied to a Markdown context and vice versa.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-137](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L137)

### Parsing State Machine (Markdown)svg image

The Markdown parser operates as a state machine:

1. **Initial State**: `current_file = None`, `in_code_block = False`
2. **Header Detected**: Sets `current_file` to path, resets accumulator
3. **Code Fence Start**: Sets `in_code_block = True`
4. **Code Fence End**: Converts accumulated lines to `PatchSet`, resets state
5. **Inside Code Block**: Appends line to accumulator

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py139-161](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L139-L161)

### HTML DOM Traversalsvg image

The HTML parser uses BeautifulSoup selectors:

1. **Find Containers**: `soup.find_all('div', class_='diff-container')`
2. **Extract Path**: `container.get('data-path')`
3. **Extract Diff**: `container.find('pre').get_text()`
4. **Create PatchSet**: `patch.fromstring(diff_text.encode('utf-8'))`

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py163-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L163-L176)

---

## Cross-Format Patchingsvg image

One of Contexter's advanced features is **cross-format patch application**: patches generated from one format can be applied to contexts in the other format.

**Diagram: Cross-Format Patch Application**

### How Cross-Format Patching Workssvg image

1. **Format-Agnostic Parsing**: Both `parse_md_patch()` and `parse_html_patch()` return identical data structures: `{file_path: PatchSet}` dictionaries [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py141-165](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L141-L165)
2. **Unified Diff Core**: The actual patch content (unified diff) is format-independent and interpreted by the `patch` library
3. **Context File Parsing**: Updater commands parse the target context file (MD or HTML) into `{file_path: content}` dictionaries using `parse_md_constructor()` or `parse_html_constructor()` [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py70-129](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L70-L129)
4. **Patch Application**: The `patch` library applies `PatchSet` objects to file contents regardless of how the patch was originally encoded
5. **Context Rebuilding**: Modified file contents are written back to the appropriate format (MD or HTML) using format-specific builders

### Practical Use Casessvg image

| Scenario | Workflow | Benefit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Format Migration** | Generate patch from MD contexts, apply to HTML context | Incrementally update after format conversion |
| **Unified Versioning** | Store patches in preferred format, apply to any context type | Single patch repository for both formats |
| **Tool Integration** | Generate HTML patches for web viewing, apply MD patches via CLI | Format flexibility in CI/CD pipelines |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L176) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md32-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L32-L33)

---

## Patch File Generation Commandssvg image

The following commands generate patch files:

| Command | Input Formats | Output Formats | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `updatecontext` | 2 MD contexts | MD or HTML patch | Standard diff-based comparison |
| `smartupdate` | 2 MD contexts or 2 directories | MD or HTML patch | rsync-based high-efficiency comparison (recommended) |
| `updatecontexthtml` | 2 HTML contexts | MD or HTML patch | HTML-specific comparison |

For detailed command documentation, see:

- [updatecontext](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.1-updatecontext)
- [smartupdate](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.3-smartupdate)
- [updatecontexthtml](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.4-updatecontexthtml)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md27-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L27-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py40-52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L40-L52)

---

## Patch File Application Commandssvg image

The following commands apply patch files:

| Command | Target Format | Patch Format | Output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `updater` | MD context | MD or HTML patch | Updated MD context |
| `updaterhtml` | HTML context | MD or HTML patch | Updated HTML context |

The commands automatically detect patch format and parse accordingly using `parse_patch_file()`.

For detailed command documentation, see:

- [updater](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.2-updater)
- [updaterhtml](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.5-updaterhtml)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md28-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L28-L33) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py44-52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L44-L52)

## Implementation Notessvg image

### Error Handlingsvg image

Both parsers return `None` if the file is not found:

- `_parse_md_patch()` [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py160](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L160-L160)
- `_parse_html_patch()` [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py169](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L169-L169)

Calling code should check for `None` returns and handle appropriately.

### Encodingsvg image

All patch parsing operations use UTF-8 encoding:

- File reads: `encoding='utf-8'` parameter [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py146-167](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L146-L167)
- Patch creation: `.encode('utf-8')` before passing to `patch.fromstring()` [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py150-175](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L150-L175)

### Line Ending Normalizationsvg image

The `rstrip('\n')` operation in the Markdown parser [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py103](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L103-L103) suggests line ending normalization, though explicit cross-platform handling is not visible in the provided code.

### Memory Efficiencysvg image

Parsers accumulate diff content in memory (`diff_lines` list) rather than streaming, which may be inefficient for very large patches with many changes. However, typical patch files are small relative to full context files.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py139-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L139-L176)
